name: cc-translate
description: A bilingual side pane that translates the conversation with your own LLM endpoint

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Anthropic-messages or OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://your-endpoint.example.com

token.title: Token
token.description: Bearer token or x-api-key for that endpoint

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id used only for translation, e.g. glm-5.3-flash

fallback_model.title: Fallback model
fallback_model.description: Tried once when the primary model fails or hits the 30s fetch limit

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Which wire format the endpoint speaks

auth.title: Auth header
auth.description: Bearer for ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN-style endpoints, x-api-key for API-key endpoints

config_path.title: Config file
config_path.description: Fallback JSON file holding base_url, token and model

auto_input.title: Translate Chinese prompts
auto_input.description: Rewrite Chinese typed in the main prompt box into English before it is sent

use_session_env.title: Use session ANTHROPIC_* env
use_session_env.description: Only when no endpoint is configured: reuse ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN. Off by default so translation never rides the session provider

send_original_on_failure.title: Send original when translation fails
send_original_on_failure.description: Off by default: a failed translation refuses the prompt and puts it back in the input box instead of sending the Chinese text

max_entries.title: History size
max_entries.description: How many conversation entries the pane keeps
